question: India and Canada signed a joint statement on energy cooperation on the sidelines of which event in January 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India Energy Week 2026.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **India and Canada signed a joint statement on energy cooperation during India Energy Week 2026 held in Goa.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The joint statement was signed between India’s Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas and Canada’s Ministry of Energy and Natural Resources.**
 
• The agreement marked the first high-level participation of a Canadian Cabinet Minister at India Energy Week.
 
• Both sides launched the renewed India–Canada Ministerial Energy Dialogue.
 
• The cooperation focuses on energy security, diversification of supply, and clean energy collaboration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• India Energy Week__

 __
 
• Flagship international energy event organised by the Government of India
 
• Provides a platform for global energy dialogue and partnerships
 
 
 
• Areas of Cooperation__
 __
 
• Liquefied Natural Gas, Liquefied Petroleum Gas and crude oil trade
 
• Renewable energy including hydrogen, biofuels and sustainable aviation fuel
 
• Critical minerals, battery storage and clean technologies
 
 
 
• Strategic Significance__
 
 
• Supports India’s growing energy demand and Canada’s export diversification
 
• Aligns with global energy transition and climate objectives
